Inox 304 chứa khoảng 18% crôm và 8% nike: Stainless steel 304 contains about 18% chromium and 8% nickel. Stainless steel 201 cuts nickel to about 3.5 - 5.5% and makes up for it with manganese. Nickel is expensive, so 201 is cheaper, but its corrosion resistance is also lower.
<0>Inox 304:</0> dùng tốt trong bếp, nhà: <0>Stainless steel 304:</0> performs well in kitchens, bathrooms, outdoors and anywhere in contact with water and cleaning agents. This is the grade we recommend for sinks, kitchen tables and outdoor railings.
<0>Inox 201:</0> phù hợp nơi khô ráo, tr: <0>Stainless steel 201:</0> suits dry, indoor locations: table and chair frames, display shelves, items with little water contact. Outdoors or near the sea, 201 tends to show rust spots after a while.
<0>Inox 316:</0> có thêm molypden, dùng: <0>Stainless steel 316:</0> contains added molybdenum, for coastal areas or contact with mild chemicals.
Nam châm không phân biệt chắc chắn được: A magnet cannot reliably tell 304 from 201, as both are almost non-magnetic. A stainless steel test reagent or a composition analyzer is more reliable. For large orders, the workshop states the grade on the quote and lets you test it with a reagent on delivery.
